overview_description.description: Atlas Discovery develops AI foundation models that learn patient drug response from pre-clinical and clinical data. The company trains large-scale models on perturbation experiments and trial datasets to encode biological state and treatment effects in a compressed latent space. Its models are used to predict which patients are likely to respond to specific drugs, enabling biomarker development and stratified enrollment in clinical trials. Atlas Discovery applies these models to design trials, estimate required enrollment, and evaluate whether trials should be run or rescued. It also builds discrete-latent models such as ExpressionVAE for modeling single-cell perturbation responses. These tools aim to connect molecular assays and clinical outcomes to inform drug development decisions.
